title: SCE TTCN-3 types manifest (wire schema v1)
description: The structural manifest of the types module the TTCN-3 export of a test suite writes, `<suite>_Types.manifest.json` beside `<suite>_Types.ttcn` (docs/adr/0091 C2; docs/SCE_TEST_PROFILE.md section 9.5). It states every definition of the module by its name, its kind and its structure, and the external codec functions the module declares and does not implement, so a consumer can hold a types module written apart from SCE, with a codec of its own, to the one the export writes. Every name is a name of the suite's documents, written as it is written, and a TTCN-3 identifier. Every value that may pass 2^53, a bound of an integer type and the number of a variant, is the text of its digits; a length and a bound in bytes are numbers. Definitions stand in the order the module holds them: the eight integer types of the type grammar, then the enumerated types, records and unions in the order of their names; the codec functions in the order of their types' names. The manifest names nothing of the run that wrote it, no generator commit and no source hash: two exports of one suite by two builds that write the same module write the same manifest, and the module's own header names its inputs. Authoritative producer is sce-build/src/ttcn3_export/manifest.rs over the model of sce-build/src/ttcn3_export/types.rs, which the module is written from too. Consumers MUST ignore unknown fields. The stability status of this surface lives in this header alone; see SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md for the shared policy.

v.description: Schema version. Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

suite.description: The suite's unit name: the stem of its document's file in lower snake case, which names its modules.

types.description: Every type definition of the module, in the order it holds them.

codec.description: The codec functions of each type a port of the suite carries: `external function <encode>(in <type> msg) return octetstring` and `external function <decode>(inout octetstring octets, out <type> msg) return integer`, whose result is the one ES 201 873-1's `decvalue` reports (0 decoded, the message's octets taken from `octets`; 1 not decoded; 2 the octets end before the message does).

identifier.description: A TTCN-3 identifier: an ASCII letter, then ASCII letters, digits and underscores.

integerText.description: An integer as the text of its decimal digits, a minus sign before a negative one.

typeDef.description: One type definition, told apart by its kind.

oneOf.description: `type integer <name> (<min> .. <max>)`: an integer type of the type grammar, named by it.
`type enumerated <name> { <variant>(<value>), ... }`: an enum, its variants in declared order with their declared numbers.
`type record <name> { ... }`: an event schema, its fields in declared order, and the event its messages travel under.
`type union <name> { ... }`: a union, one alternative per case in its tag enum's order, named by the case's variant.

field.description: A field of a record: its name, its type, and whether it is `optional`.

typeExpr.description: The type of a field, an alternative or an element, its kind named as TTCN-3 spells the type.

oneOf.description: A definition of the module, by its name.
A text: TTCN-3 counts its length in characters, so its bound, in bytes of UTF-8, is stated here and held by the codec.
A byte string, its bound in octets.
A record written in place: the empty record of a union's case that holds none.

codec.description: The codec functions of one message type.
